'''2011 Luxembourg Regionals David Destefanis LS Rebel Strike Team''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[David Destefanis]] at [[2011 Luxembourg Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Rebel Strike Team / Garrison Destroyed|Endor-L-rebelstriketeam.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' DDT's RST Bedtime
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Virtual Block 7.2]]
